item.title: Florida native, streamer Tfue buys Woody's Waterfront in St. Pete Beach
item.description: ST. PETE BEACH, Fla. (WFLA)— An iconic St. Pete Beach restaurant, Woody's Waterfront, has been bought by a local Twitch streamer. Turner Tenney, known as Tfue, purchased the property for $2.4 million, according to the Tampa Bay Business Journal. item.description: Divers with the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office recently showed off how they train for extreme rescue and recovery situations.

item.title: New affordable housing in the works for East Tampa
item.description: A groundbreaking ceremony was held on Wednesday for the third phase of Tampa's "Infill Housing Program", an initiative that aims to bring new affordable housing to East Tampa.

item.title: Massive great white shark returns to Florida coast after year-long journey to Canada
item.description: A massive great white shark pinged off Florida's coast on Monday, just over a year since its last visit to the Sunshine State's waters.

item.title: Environmental group wins court ruling against Florida in fight to shut down Alligator Alcatraz
